protocol: minigrid_decide_stream_rule_adaptation: stage 1 learns identity->choice rule 0 on a 4-episode stream; stage 2 flips the rule (choice = complement) and the adaptation curve measures how quickly each controller recovers on reward feedback only; revision mode controls the weight-domain surgery (continue=plain retraining, decay=strong weight decay, reset=reinit from scratch); PPO on-policy throughout; no privileged state.
